painpoints.text: Run 01M2SXPBN8SGCVW228TNA5DZEJ implementer: context_read returned 'unknown context key' for current_seed_id/current_seed_title/current_seed_brief with an EMPTY available-keys list — the planner's brief keys were unreachable via context_read and had to be recovered from the run projection (fabro_run_get checkpoint diff) and `sd show fabro-c42f`. Fix idea: implementer preamble_allow_keys should also grant context_read access, or the journal fallback should be documented in the implementer prompt (it currently only documents seed-id recovery).

observations: fabro-c42f root cause is engine-version skew (old deployed engine + PR #235 assets), not a current-tree defect; the durable fix family is verifying engine redeploy after engine-side seed merges — filed as mx-188538, no new seed created (filing is the planner's role).
